definitions.explanation: A point where something is interrupted or divided, either in time or in a continuous sequence.
A physical line or opening where something has been cut or separated.

examples.japanese: ⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{切|き}れ{目|め}。
⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{切|き}れ{目|め}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{休憩|きゅうけい}→休憩：00262_kyuukei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧。
examples.english: To take a break during a pause in work.
I waited for a break in the rain and went outside.

examples.japanese: ⟦{袋|ふくろ}→袋：00837_fukuro⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{切|き}れ{目|め}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧。
examples.english: To make a cut in a bag.
To fold along the cut line on the paper.

examples.japanese: ⟦{壁|かべ}→壁：01290_kabe⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{細|ほそ}い→細い：02962_hosoi⟧{切|き}れ{目|め}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{入|はい}っていた→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
examples.english: There was a thin crack in the wall.

notes:
A compound noun from ⟦{切|き}れる→切れる：01936_kireru⟧ (to cut/break) + ⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧ (point/spot). Refers to any point of division or interruption, whether abstract (time, conversation) or physical (a slit, crack).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{切|き}れ{目|め}: a pause in conversation
- ⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{切|き}れ{目|め}: a break in the rain
- ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{切|き}れ{目|め}: a break between tasks
- {切|き}れ{目|め}⟦なく→ない：01118_nai⟧: without interruption, continuously
- {切|き}れ{目|め}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧: to make a cut/incision

PROVERB:
⟦{金|かね}→金：02618_kane⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{切|き}れ{目|め}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{縁|えん}→縁：02182_en⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{切|き}れ{目|め}: "When the money runs out, the relationship ends" — a well-known saying about how financial problems can end relationships.
